Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Udai usually hope their child will grow to embody joy, delight and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The name Udai is often given to a child when there is a feeling of hope and expectation that things will get better. Furthermore, in Hindu epics, there are several characters with the name Uday, such as the king Udayana in the Mahabharata and the sage Udai in the Puranas.
